detail: Asserts ProblemDetails title 'Invalid order status change', which the story does not state. Assert only status 409, ProblemDetails shape, and the detail text.
Expected body is 'the ShipOrderCommandValidator message', not a concrete string. Name the exact message or assert only status 400 and a non-empty string body.

Asserts the body contains 'No orderId found', which is not in the story (it says only 'validation messages'). Loosen to status 400 with a non-empty message, or note that the text comes from the existing validator.

Order ids are reused across cases with conflicting end states (order 6 is Paid in TC-02 and TC-12, and TC-12 transitions it to Shipped; order 5 Shipped is shared by TC-01/04/09/13/14). The plan must state that each test seeds its own order (or uses a fresh order id) so results do not depend on test order.
